reading.action: Floor 2: lure the swarm to the dry edge (foot-in, dart back), then max Ember Burst on the massed cluster, retreat to stairwell to observe
reading.gate: x0.6 partial-strand (lured to exposed edge + AREA on surfaced massed swarm; better than x0.3 in-water, less than full strand-on-dry)
reading.result: BEST HIT YET, ZERO RISK. Stayed on dry stone throughout (no grapple exposure). Lure (warmth-bait, true read) + AREA burst on clustered swarm = 36 dmg, Glut ~70->~34. Recoil drove the front off the lip. FIRST LIVE-PRESSURE use of Ember Burst -> JOURNEYMAN demonstration (clean, margin 33): displayed 7->11, crosses Apprentice->Journeyman (the live-reliability the yard couldn't certify; skillBonus now +2). Focus 104->60 (-44, max burst). Stamina 56->53 (lure footwork). Ember Affinity +1 (live heat-strike) -> 9 (one short of hidden 10 = Manipulation promotion). No Glut counter (dry-stone + clean roll). Reads the winning line from the stairwell: lure + burst from dry, repeat.
